scope: Installation, testing and acceptance of 12 explicitly selected KS-15-RC-H2.5-D400-DN200 precast reinforced-concrete circular inspection chambers. Chamber bodies, base and cover slabs, covers and frames, steps, joint seals, inlet and outlet connectors, benching, waterproofing, bedding, earthworks, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved sewerage design organization, precast-chamber and cover manufacturers, geotechnical engineer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved chamber layout, elevations, depth schedule and connection schedule
approved chamber-body, slab, cover, frame, step, seal and connector specification
approved benching, waterproofing and bedding schedule
approved excavation, backfill and excess-soil quantities
installation method with labor and mechanism quantities
survey, watertightness or flow-testing and acceptance program
conditional dewatering, excavation-shoring and pavement-restoration schedules
supplier body-package quantity and approved retained spare-body quantity
forbiddenClaims: whole sewer pipe or network scope inherited from a route template
chamber spacing, earthwork, material, labor or mechanism quantities derived from route length
automatic chamber quantity from route length
automatic dewatering, shoring or pavement restoration
universal spare-body or supplier package quantity
